context: An English tweet from the SemEval-2017 sentiment analysis dataset. The tweets were found by searching Twitter for popular topics of the time, such as public figures, products, places, events and political issues, and were posted between 2012 and early 2017. At least five crowd workers labelled the overall sentiment of each tweet.
